name: City Discipleship Presbyterian Church

address.full: 7th Floor, IOI Boulevard, Unit B, 01, Jalan Kenari 5, Bandar Puchong Jaya, 47170 Puchong, Selangor, Malaysia

whoWeAre: CDPC Puchong is a church made up of diverse followers of Jesus who gather together for Christ-centred worship, Scripture-based expository preaching and grace-enabled spirituality.
tagline: Created for good but broken by evil, we believe God rescues us by his grace and renews us to be people of healing.
word: We seek to centre ourselves on Christ, the Gospel and the Word.
library: A library with a great collection of English books with a Story Time session, catered for people from toddlers to adults.
